title: Alert/Notification Schema Registry
description: Registers all alert and notification JSON Schema files for the alert-notification capability.

alert-instance.description: An alert instance representing a normalized, deduplicated alert fact.

alert-rule.description: An alert rule definition for source-type-specific alert generation.

storage-alert-rule.description: An executable storage metric rule with stable resource identity and SecretReference channels.

silence.description: A time-bound silence rule with matchers for suppressing notifications.

notification-policy.description: A notification routing policy with matchers, channels, escalation, and schedule.

notification-channel.description: A notification channel configuration with type, capability, and secret reference.

notification-job.description: A notification dispatch job with policy snapshot and priority.

delivery-record.description: A delivery record tracking the state of a single notification attempt.

delivery-attempt.description: A single delivery attempt record with result, duration, and trace.
